item.title: Sky is bringing back this iconic British channel
item.description: Remember Sky One – the British channel that launched in the 1980s, and was home to many original programmes and American series? Well, it’s coming back, bringing together well-known and completely new shows. During its 39 years, the channel broadcast British hits such as The Russell Howard Hour and An Idiot Abroad, and allowed viewers to catch up on the likes of The X-Files, The Simpsons, The Middle and Star Trek. item.title: YouTube’s background playback on mobile browsers is now paywalled

item.title: A future Gemini update could unlock a world of possibilities, but will you trust it?
item.description: Google’s Gemini AI assistant is set for a huge upgrade in its basic capabilities, as recently discovered code reveals. A new report has discovered evidence of a new, more self-sufficient Google Gemini AI assistant in the latest beta version of the Google app. There are references to a new feature codenamed “bonobo” in the code, which seems to relate to “screen automation”. This will seemingly relate to Gemini being able to place orders on your behalf using third-party apps such as Uber or Lyft.
